summary: Conditionally dispatches a virtual method on a stored object and resets two state words on a global object. If this[2] is non-null, invokes the virtual at vtable+16 on it. If dword_8AFE88 is non-null, zeros the dwords at offsets 424 and 420 of that object.

operations.description: Read the stored object pointer v1 from this[2].
If this[2] is non-null, dispatch the virtual method at vtable offset 16 on the object.
If dword_8AFE88 is non-null, clear two state words on the referenced global object.
Write 0 to the dword at dword_8AFE88 + 424.
Write 0 to the dword at dword_8AFE88 + 420.
Return the last computed result (0 when the global branch ran, otherwise the virtual call result).

unresolved: Identity of the object at this[2], its class, and the virtual at vtable+16.
Identity of the global object dword_8AFE88 and the meaning of the reset words at +420 and +424.
Relation between the virtual dispatch result and the 0 return value of the global branch.
